# gigahost_dns_records (Data Source)

Returns every DNS record in a zone, by zone name or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every record in a zone.
data "gigahost_dns_records" "example" {
  zone = "example.com"
}

output "record_names" {
  value = [for r in data.gigahost_dns_records.example.records : r.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) Zone name (e.g. `example.com`) or zone ID.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) Every record in the zone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Unique identifier.
- `name` (String) Record name, relative to the zone. `@` is the apex.
- `priority` (Number) Priority; used by MX records.
- `ttl` (Number) Time to live in seconds.
- `type` (String) Record type, e.g. `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `TXT`.
- `value` (String) Record value.
